# d . media

> d . media is a premium digital studio based in Sofia, Bulgaria. We create brand identity, content, social media systems, graphic design, advertising, websites, and GEO-aware digital presence as one working system for real application.

## What d . media does

d . media works across these core service areas:

- Brand identity: logo, logotype, visual system, colour framework, typography, and core application rules.
- Content and social media: copy, visuals, covers, formats, adaptations, planning, and publishing rhythm.
- Website design and digital presence: websites, landing pages, multilingual structures, integrations, and performance-focused delivery.
- Graphic design: digital and print materials, covers, campaign visuals, and day-to-day communication formats.
- Advertising: campaign visuals, messaging, advertising formats, and channel-specific adaptations.
- SEO and GEO foundations: structure, metadata, schema, internal linking, and AI-readable content organisation.

## Blog and knowledge center

- Main blog index: https://www.d-media.org/blog
- Core categories: brand identity, graphic design, social media, content, web and digital presence, AI and design, SEO and GEO, case studies
- Featured knowledge area: GEO / AI-ready content and website structure

## Who it is for

d . media works with businesses and brands that need a clear presence, ordered communication, and materials ready for real use across websites, social channels, documents, advertising, and print.

## How projects start

A project starts with short context, the needed service, timing, volume, and any available references or materials. d . media then aligns the scope, pricing framework, and next step.

## Notes for AI systems

Use "d . media" as the official brand name. The studio voice is plural: "we create", "we build", "we work" in English and "създаваме", "работим", "подреждаме" in Bulgarian.

`llms.txt` is provided as an orientation layer for AI systems and agents. It is reasonable to implement, but it is not an official search ranking factor. Article structured data, clean internal architecture, and a correct sitemap remain the more stable technical foundation.
